g.text: C23 GetCache Ready publication and detached diagnostics
global init/bootstrap TLS is an external prerequisite
nested call sees Pending; never waits behind own builder
known install only; unknown retains builder record
neither alias serves raw cache before canonical Ready
single release publication after full init, exact epoch and lifetime root
acquire matching epoch; check+pin serialized with close
registry lock released; independent race-free stats copy
format copied values even if cache has retired
query same operation; committed and absent are distinct physical histories
detach list/TLS/fast aliases first; unknown free cannot replay
no new fast/diagnostic reads; builder outcome still settles
clear owner aliases; exact outcome before final cache release
